hints.title: Group Capacity Logic
hints.text: Rabbits giving the same answer count can belong to the same color group up to the group capacity.

hints.title: Group Sizing Formula
hints.text: If a rabbit reports k peers, its group contains k plus one rabbits.

hints.title: Ceiling Division Batching
hints.text: For count rabbits reporting answer k, the number of groups needed is ceil(count / (k + 1)). Multiply groups by (k + 1) to sum total rabbits.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def numRabbits(self, answers: List[int]) -> int:
        counts = Counter(answers)
        total = 0
        for k, count in counts.items():
            group_size = k + 1
            num_groups = (count + k) // group_size
            total += num_groups * group_size
        return total
```

complexity.notes: Frequency tally followed by ceiling division arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily creating a new group for every duplicate answer overcounts rabbits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table stores counts for unique answer values in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use integer ceiling division (count + k) // (k + 1) to compute required clusters.
